payout_quote: You'll earn points called SB for taking online surveys and other activities. Redeem your points for an Amazon.com Gift Card, PayPal cash, or other gift cards to popular stores. PayPal account funds can be transferred to your bank account. It takes 100 SB to reach $1.00 in rewards. You can cash out once you have enough for at least a $1 Amazon.com Gift Card. (Official Swagbucks rewards page, indexed 2026-09-23; page blocked direct fetch, captured via search index)
timing: SB credits after each activity; redeem any time once you have enough (from $1 Amazon cards); rewards take up to 10 business days to arrive
eligibility: 13+; free account; available in US, UK, Canada, Australia and other supported countries
steps: Earn SB: surveys, grocery receipt scans (Magic Receipts), online shopping cashback, games, daily polls, web search
Redeem from as little as $1 (Amazon gift card) or save for PayPal cash
PayPal funds can be transferred to your bank
catches: Most activities pay pennies - surveys and videos are the classic 'beer money' grind; typical daily earnings are $1-$5
PayPal cash-out has a higher minimum ($25) than gift cards ($1-$3), so cash takes much longer than gift cards
Some high-paying 'discover deals' require signing up for trials or services - skip any that cost money or are hard to cancel
SB can be revoked if an offer advertiser doesn't confirm your action - game and shopping SB often takes weeks to credit
This is not hourly work; the effective rate is usually a few dollars an hour at best
